executiveSummary: Iteration 000042 introduces the `nvst auto` pipeline command and fixes `audit prototype` state persistence. All 7 FRs and 3 USs comply. 35 unit tests pass, typecheck is clean.
minorObservations: No integration/e2e test for the full `nvst auto` CLI subprocess flow — unit tests mock sub-commands.
`--agent` uses `validateAgent` + null-guard instead of Commander's `.requiredOption()` — functional but non-idiomatic.
Strict-mode guardrail throws without a pre-throw warning; consistent with existing contract but worth noting.
conclusionsAndRecommendations: Implementation is fully compliant and production-ready. Refactor should add an integration smoke-test and switch `--agent` to `.requiredOption()` in the auto command.

refactorPlan.title: Integration smoke-test for `nvst auto`
refactorPlan.description: Add `tests/it_000042_integration-auto.test.ts` that invokes `runAuto` with real state helpers and a stubbed agent, asserting all three phases run in order, `prototype_audit.status === 'completed'` is written to state, and the function resolves cleanly.

refactorPlan.title: Use `.requiredOption` for `--agent` in auto command
refactorPlan.description: In `src/cli.ts`, change the `auto` command's `--agent` from `.option()` to `.requiredOption()` so Commander natively enforces its presence and emits a standard error message when missing.
